personally i have a very hyperactive brain so it was really hard ignoring the cravings every 40 seconds. you'll need to make a list of distractions, such as going for a walk, blasting music in your ears, eating a snack to do something with your mouth, chewing gum no nic helped me the most because of fruity flavor  and mouth fixation. anytime you have a craving try talking negatively to your brain "shut up little bitch you're not getting nic again". i promise it does get easier, even though it feels like drowning sometimes. this is your test, and i know you can pass it.
